newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stock mkt, banks close on King's birthday.
newsitem.headline: Thai stock mkt, banks close on King's birthday.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET), banks as well as public and private sectors are closed on Thursday to celebrate King Bhumibol Adulyadej's birthday.
The king, who celebrated his 50 years accession to the throne earlier this year, celebrated his 69th birthday on Thursday.
The SET, banks, government and private offices will be open on Friday.
